metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘You got this, even if you don’t’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I actually land that?
Enemy probably shouting ‘no way’ at their screen.
Click if your aim’s a mystery but the game’s feeling generous.
